trends.name: Iran Ceasefire Fragility & Israel Escalation
trends.summary: U.S.-Iran ceasefire is rapidly deteriorating with Israel conducting strikes on Lebanon and Iran activating air defenses in Isfahan/Kerman. Netanyahu signals readiness to resume fighting; Iran's Foreign Minister demands U.S. choose between ceasefire or continued war. This geopolitical escalation directly impacts energy markets and equity volatility.

trends.name: Fed Rate Path Uncertainty & Inflation Debate
trends.summary: FOMC minutes reveal growing debate among policymakers on rate direction: many see 'strong case' for two-sided language on rates, some argue inflation higher-for-longer could warrant hikes, while most see protracted war could trigger job losses demanding cuts. Fed staff downgraded economic projections relative to January. Market facing 50/50 directional uncertainty on 2026 rate policy.

trends.name: AI Spending Justification & Tech Valuations
trends.summary: Meta unveils new AI model after spending billions on AI infrastructure, attempting to catch Google and OpenAI. Palantir DevCon5 showcases AI disruption thesis. Smart money is shifting from speculative AI chip bets to guaranteed-return assets, signaling saturation concerns in AI narrative and potential sector rotation.

trends.name: Memory Chip Rally on Risk-Off Resolution
trends.summary: Micron and memory stocks surge as Iran ceasefire redirects market focus back to AI boom narrative. Risk-on sentiment rekindled with reduced geopolitical premium, allowing semiconductor sector to recover. This represents tactical rotation back into growth/AI plays from defensive positioning.

trends.name: Oil & Energy Complex Realignment
trends.summary: Oil price plunge from ceasefire relief is lifting hardware-store stocks and cruise lines (Carnival soars). Delta sees $300M refinery boost from lower fuel costs but cuts growth plans. Energy-sensitive sectors experiencing immediate relief, with implications for inflation trajectory and transport cost normalization.

trends.name: Trump Economic Adviser Appointment & Policy Direction
trends.summary: Fed Economist Phelan emerges as front-runner for top Trump economic adviser role, signaling potential policy shift. NATO withdrawal discussions also underway, suggesting significant foreign policy/defense spending implications. Market positioning ahead of clarity on protectionist vs. growth-focused policies.

trends.name: Healthcare Sector & Medicaid Policy Shifts
trends.summary: CMS issues new guidance limiting federal Medicaid & CHIP funding for noncitizens, effective Oct 1. CURE healthcare fund sees pullback presenting buying opportunity. Policy changes creating uncertainty and potential margin pressures on healthcare providers and insurers.

trends.name: Defense Sector & Palantir Validation
trends.summary: Palantir rating upgraded on thesis that 'the world changed when Silicon Valley met defense.' Company positioned as defense disruption play amid geopolitical tensions and renewed focus on military-industrial complex. Iran conflict validates defense sector rotation.

trends.name: Real Estate & Mortgage Market Uncertainty
trends.summary: Stewart Information Services faces Q1 earnings scrutiny as key indicator of home-buying market health. Broader real estate sector facing headwinds from elevated mortgage rates and economic uncertainty, with spring selling season impact pending.

trends.name: Consumer Discretionary Sector Divergence
trends.summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods presents at J.P. Morgan retail forum; Costco rated unattractive for new investors despite strength. Retail sector showing divergence between discretionary winners and those facing margin compression from pricing power loss. Consumer health check remains mixed.

trends.name: Cybersecurity & AI Opportunity (Zscaler/Ouster)
trends.summary: Zscaler identified as generational opportunity to buy AI tailwinds at discount; Ouster sensors play positioning for AI infrastructure buildout. Niche security and sensor plays benefiting from AI infrastructure acceleration and enterprise security spending surge.

trends.name: Inflation Expectations & Year-Ahead Outlook
trends.summary: Prediction markets on Kalshi show uncertainty on whether inflation peaks at 4.0% this year. Fed minutes reinforce 'higher for longer' inflation concern. Key macro variable determining entire rate path and asset allocation strategy for remainder of 2026.
